description: Defines a class for JinaAI embeddings integration, including an extended class for late chunking and a node class implementing INode for embedding generation.

classes.name: ExtendedJinaEmbeddings
classes.description: An extension of JinaEmbeddings with support for late chunking.

classes.name: JinaAIEmbedding_Embeddings
classes.description: Implements INode to provide Jina AI embedding generation with configurable parameters.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ExtendedJinaEmbeddings or JinaAIEmbedding_Embeddings class with specific parameters.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the embedding model with node data and options, returning the model instance.
